archetypes.name: dyn-slot-canonicalization
archetypes.rationale: _normalize_slot is shared across 6 aggregator call sites; verify the new .txt/-output suffix stripping is symmetric and collision-safe
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the change to _normalize_slot in python/review_aggregate.py, which now strips a trailing .txt and the artifact-suffix family (-output-ns-retry, -output, -ns-retry) before comparing reviewer slots. Verify the canonicalization is applied symmetrically to both the input_slot_set construction and the merge-output slot check inside _validate_aggregate_output, so a merged finding naming the bare slot reconciles with an input attribution carrying the -output suffix. Check the other call sites (_input_blocks_by_slot, _output_reviewer_slots_norm, _scope_input_blocks_for_merge, _check_revision_traceability) are not broken by the broader stripping. Confirm no two legitimately-distinct reviewer slots can collapse to one key, and that a degenerate slot (e.g. a bare "-output") does not yield a spurious match. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
